candidates.teaser: Mercury goes retrograde in 8 days — and it's happening in one of the most dangerous signs for communication.
candidates.video_title: Mercury Retrograde Hits in 8 Days — Are You Ready?
candidates.video_description: Mercury stations retrograde on October 24th in Scorpio 18°. With Venus already retrograde in the same sign, this double Scorpio retrograde pressure is rare. Secrets, contracts, and deep conversations are all at risk.
candidates.script: Eight days. That's how long you have before Mercury goes retrograde — inside Scorpio. Mercury stations on October 24th at 18° Scorpio, and Venus is already retrograde in the same sign right now. Two planets both reversing in Scorpio means secrets surface, texts get misread, and conversations cut deeper than anyone intended. This isn't the retrograde to sign contracts or confess feelings on impulse. Which sign are you — because some of you will feel this more than others.

candidates.topic: Four Planets Retrograde — Venus Saturn Uranus Neptune
candidates.teaser: Four planets are retrograde right now — and one of them is about to drag your love life back to places you thought you'd escaped.
candidates.video_title: 4 Planets Retrograde Right Now — One Ruins Relationships
candidates.video_description: Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde simultaneously. Venus retrograde in Scorpio is the most personal disruptor — forcing a reckoning in love, desire, and self-worth. The outer planets slow the collective; Venus makes it personal.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde right now — Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune — and most people are only watching Mercury. But Venus retrograde in Scorpio at 5° is the one quietly dismantling relationships from the inside. It doesn't break things loudly. It makes you question whether what you wanted was ever real. Saturn retrograde in Aries adds a ruthless audit of your discipline. The sky is asking you to review everything — not punish you, but rebuild you. Are you listening?

candidates.topic: First Quarter Moon in Capricorn — Action vs Resistance
candidates.teaser: The First Quarter Moon in Capricorn is forcing a decision right now — push forward or admit the structure was never solid.
candidates.video_title: First Quarter Moon in Capricorn — The Test Is Right Now
candidates.video_description: Today's First Quarter Moon sits at 2° Capricorn, squaring the Libra Sun. This is the crisis point of the lunar cycle — Capricorn demands results while Libra keeps weighing options. Tension between action and indecision peaks today.
candidates.script: The First Quarter Moon in Capricorn isn't gentle — it's a test. Right now the Moon sits at 2° Capricorn squaring the Libra Sun, and that tension is the point. Capricorn wants structure, results, and commitment. Libra keeps reconsidering. First Quarter Moons expose the cracks in whatever you started at the New Moon. If your plan was solid, this pushes you forward. If it wasn't, you'll feel it today. The question isn't whether to move — it's whether you actually built something worth moving toward.

candidates.topic: Mars Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — Still Active, What It Means Long-Term
candidates.teaser: Mars and Jupiter are still fused together in Leo — and astrologers say this kind of energy only comes around once in over a decade.
candidates.video_title: Mars + Jupiter in Leo — The Rarest Fire of the Decade
candidates.video_description: Mars at 10° Leo and Jupiter at 22° Leo are both traveling through the same sign, amplifying ambition, performance, and ego-driven risk. This configuration supercharges creative confidence but also inflates pride dangerously.
candidates.script: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now — and if you've felt an almost irrational surge of ambition lately, that's exactly why. Mars at 10° Leo fuels the drive; Jupiter at 22° expands it into something that feels almost too big to contain. In astrology, this combination in a fixed fire sign is called a combustion of confidence — it builds empires and it burns bridges. The shadow side is that Leo energy needs an audience, and Jupiter makes the ego louder. The fire is real. The question is what you're burning it on.

candidates.teaser: Your 4th house reveals something about your family and childhood that your Sun sign never could — and most people completely overlook it.
candidates.video_title: The 4th House — The Wound and the Root
candidates.video_description: The 4th house in astrology rules home, family, ancestry, and emotional foundations. It's the most private sector of the birth chart — what you hide even from yourself. The sign and planets here reveal how early life shaped your emotional blueprint.
candidates.script: Your 4th house is the part of your birth chart nobody talks about — and it might be the most important one. It rules your roots: your family, your childhood home, the emotional patterns you inherited before you were old enough to question them. The sign on your 4th house cusp describes the emotional environment you grew up in. A planet sitting inside it? That's a wound that became a foundation. Most people spend their whole lives acting out their 4th house without ever reading it. What's in yours?
